name: xylonic
description: Modern Subsonic music streaming client with Spotify-like UI. Stream your music library from any Subsonic-compatible server (Navidrome, Airsonic, Gonic) with full playback controls, album art, and responsive design.

scripts.electron:build: node scripts/build-timed.js "node scripts/write-build-info.js release && npm run prebuild:clean && npm run build && electron-builder"
scripts.electron:build:win: node scripts/build-timed.js "node scripts/write-build-info.js release && npm run prebuild:clean && npm run build && electron-builder --win"
scripts.electron:build:win-portable: node scripts/build-timed.js "node scripts/write-build-info.js release && npm run prebuild:clean && npm run build && electron-builder --win portable"
scripts.electron:build:mac: node scripts/build-timed.js "node scripts/write-build-info.js release && npm run prebuild:clean && npm run build && electron-builder --mac"
scripts.electron:build:linux: node scripts/build-timed.js "node scripts/write-build-info.js release && npm run prebuild:clean && npm run build && electron-builder --linux"
scripts.electron:build:linux-tar: node scripts/build-timed.js "node scripts/write-build-info.js release && npm run prebuild:clean && npm run build && electron-builder --linux tar.gz"
scripts.electron:build:linux-appimage: node scripts/build-timed.js "node scripts/write-build-info.js release && npm run prebuild:clean && npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage"
scripts.electron:build:linux-portable: node scripts/build-timed.js "node scripts/write-build-info.js release && npm run prebuild:clean && npm run build && electron-builder --linux tar.gz"
scripts.electron:build:all-portable: node scripts/build-timed.js "node scripts/write-build-info.js release && npm run prebuild:clean && npm run build && electron-builder --win portable --linux tar.gz"
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:run: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap run android
scripts.ios:setup: npm run build && ([ -d ios ] || npx cap add ios) && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
